overview: The ancient Force-balanced society of Tython's Temples, governing Je'daii adepts before the Jedi and Sith orders diverged.
history: Je'daii Order governed galactic affairs during the Pre-Republic. Detailed chronicles, succession rules, and institutional structure will be expanded in a future update.
significance: Je'daii Order shaped the political identity of its era and remains a reference point when historians compare later governments across the Star Wars timeline.
notableEvents: Je'daii Order established as a governing authority in galactic records
